question: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) sanctioned $2.3bn fund to which of the following countries in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **International Monetary Fund (IMF)** sanctioned a significant financial package of **$2.3 billion** to **Pakistan** in **May 2025** to help the country navigate its ongoing economic challenges.
 
• This funding was approved under the **Extended Fund Facility (EFF)**, aiming to provide **Pakistan** with the necessary **liquidity** to stabilize its **balance of payments** and bolster its **foreign exchange reserves**.
 
• The approval came after **Pakistan** demonstrated a commitment to stringent **structural reforms**, including measures to increase **tax revenue**, adjust **energy tariffs**, and maintain a **market-determined exchange rate**.
 
• The **$2.3 billion** disbursement is part of a larger multi-year program designed to bring **macroeconomic stability** and promote **sustainable growth** in the South Asian nation.
